_comment: Top-level release pins consumed by setup.py. claude-context ships as an npm package. Its MCP server is `@zilliz/claude-context-mcp`, which depends on `@zilliz/claude-context-core` for the indexing engine (splitters, embeddings, Milvus clients, Merkle sync). setup.py installs both via `npm install --prefix .cache/` into an isolated node_modules, then verifies advertised MCP tools match the pin. The FAQ 'fully-local' path substitutes Milvus (docker) for Zilliz Cloud and Ollama for OpenAI/VoyageAI/Gemini — this lock pins the local-only versions used by the lab. Bump claude_context_mcp.version here, run `npm view @zilliz/claude-context-mcp@<version> dist.integrity` on a supported host, and copy the sha512 into claude_context_mcp.integrity below (informational; npm itself is the enforcer).

claude_context_mcp.integrity_source: informational; enforced at install time by npm against the registry-published dist.integrity

claude_context_core._comment: Indexing engine and vector-db clients used by the MCP server. Version-locked to match claude_context_mcp.version so a coherent surface ships.

milvus._comment: Local Milvus (standalone) is the vector backend for the fully-local path. Wave 1 caught that v2.4.13 fails claude-context's default hybrid (dense + BM25 sparse) collection load with the SDK version pinned by claude-context; v2.5.20 loads it on first attempt. This is a real reproducibility note — an operator who tries v2.4 will hit the same wall.

milvus_etcd._comment: Milvus standalone requires etcd for metadata; this is the version documented in the milvus-io docker compose recipe.

milvus_minio._comment: Milvus standalone requires MinIO for object storage. MinIO no longer publishes to Docker Hub's `minio/minio` namespace (verified in Wave 1: `docker pull minio/minio:latest` returns 'repository does not exist'); the canonical registry is now quay.io. Version documented in the milvus-io docker compose recipe.
milvus_minio.licence: AGPL-3.0-only (server); note the licence when embedding in commercial products

ollama._comment: Local embedding provider. setup.py --check verifies Ollama is installed and reachable at OLLAMA_HOST (default 127.0.0.1:11434), then pulls the pinned embedding model. This replaces the OPENAI_API_KEY + OPENAI_BASE_URL path documented in the claude-context quickstart.

ollama_embedding_model._comment: Local embedding model pulled by setup.py --install. nomic-embed-text is a 768-dim open-weights embedding model, ~137MB, well-suited to code because it was trained on mixed code + text corpora. claude-context's Ollama provider treats it as a drop-in replacement for OpenAI text-embedding-3-small at the same 768 dimension.
